notes: Hashes MUST be filled in by running the regenerator on a connected machine before cutting a release.
The installer rejects any file whose SHA-256 does not match the value here.
Both the auto-download (pip + HF) and sideload paths verify against the same manifest.

Bumping any pinned version requires bumping `manifest_version` AND running the regenerator so the consumer-side installer can detect 'install on disk is from an older manifest, re-run' via the saved `embedding_bits_install_state.manifest_sha256` row.

wheels.name: torch
wheels.rationale: CPU-only wheel from the PyTorch index. The default PyPI torch ships ~3 GB of CUDA libraries we don't need (the GPU is reserved for the chat model on the operator's Ollama host). v0.1.1 bump from 2.5.1+cpu -- 7 minors. torch is HF-stack-independent (sentence-transformers + transformers both accept torch>=1.11), so this bumps standalone ahead of the tokenizers/huggingface-hub/transformers/sentence-transformers atomic group. Platform tag advanced from bare linux_x86_64 to manylinux_2_28_x86_64 (glibc 2.28+; Debian bookworm slim base = glibc 2.36, satisfied). sha256 from the download.pytorch.org simple-index #sha256 fragment (the same hash pip verifies on install).

wheels.name: sentence-transformers
wheels.rationale: In-process embedding wrapper around HuggingFace transformers. Detects torch installed already and skips the duplicate pull.

wheels.name: transformers
wheels.rationale: sentence-transformers transitive dep. Pinned explicitly so the install doesn't drift on a future sentence-transformers minor bump.

wheels.name: tokenizers
wheels.rationale: HuggingFace Rust binary for fast tokenization. Manylinux wheel â€” works inside the slim-debian container.

wheels.name: huggingface-hub
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of transformers + sentence-transformers. The installer disables HF telemetry via env vars before importing.

wheels.name: safetensors
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of transformers for the safe model-weight format. Manylinux wheel.

wheels.name: regex
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of transformers tokenizers.

wheels.name: filelock
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of huggingface-hub + transformers for cache lock semantics.

wheels.name: packaging
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of transformers (transformers.utils.versions imports `from packaging import version` at module-load time). Bit the first real-bytes install on the deploy host 2026-05-18: pip --no-deps installed all 18 manifest wheels but transformers couldn't import. The find_spec-based verify gate missed it because find_spec returns True when the directory exists regardless of whether the module's own imports succeed.

wheels.name: fsspec
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of huggingface-hub for file-system abstraction (only the local-fs backend is exercised at runtime; HF endpoints disabled via env).

wheels.name: scikit-learn
wheels.rationale: Soft transitive of sentence-transformers (used for cosine + nearest-neighbour helpers). Pinned to keep the install reproducible. v0.1.1 bump from 1.5.2 -- 3 minors; manylinux platform tag advanced from _2_17/2014 to _2_27/2_28 (requires glibc 2.27+; both Debian bookworm + bullseye satisfy; matches the scipy tag already in this manifest). sentence-transformers 3.3.1 takes scikit-learn with no version pin so 1.8.0 satisfies. No direct sklearn imports in our src/ or tests/ surface -- exercised only via sentence-transformers internals on the lazy-install runtime path.

wheels.name: scipy
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of scikit-learn. Bumped from 1.14.1 â†’ 1.17.1 (2026-05-18) to clear the runtime warning `A NumPy version >=1.23.5 and <2.3.0 is required for this version of SciPy (detected version 2.4.4)` from the v0.1.0 install. scipy 1.17.x declares `numpy <2.7, >=1.26.4` which cleanly covers the base image's numpy 2.4.4. Operator preference (2026-05-18): push forward on version, don't pin numpy back. manylinux_2_27/2_28 wheel works on the slim-debian-bookworm base image (glibc 2.36).

wheels.name: joblib
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of scikit-learn for parallel-backend dispatch.

wheels.name: threadpoolctl
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of scikit-learn for BLAS thread management.

wheels.name: pillow
wheels.rationale: Optional transitive of sentence-transformers for image-embedding models we don't use. Pin keeps the install graph deterministic; can be removed in a future trim pass if size becomes a concern. v0.1.1 bump from 11.0.0 -- 1 major (Pillow 12). No direct PIL imports in our src/ or tests/, so the major-version API removals don't reach our code; exercised only via sentence-transformers internals. manylinux tag unchanged (_2_17/2014; glibc 2.17+).

wheels.name: sympy
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of torch for symbolic math (FX graph rewriting in torch.compile path; not exercised at embedding time but resolved at import).

wheels.name: mpmath
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of sympy.

wheels.name: networkx
wheels.rationale: Required transitive of torch (FX graph IR). Not exercised at embedding time but resolved at import.

wheels.name: jinja2
wheels.rationale: Already shipped in the base image (templates), but torch lists it as a hard transitive. Same version pinned in requirements.lock so the lazy install layers are a no-op for jinja2 specifically.

models.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
models.rationale: Default embedding model. 384-dim â€” note: this is 384, not 768; sent_mail_index.dimension currently stores 384 for MiniLM rows. Operator can switch to a different model via the AI Backends form; the installer will fetch that model lazily on first use (with hash verification disabled for operator-chosen models â€” the manifest only covers the shipped default).
